Platform Overview
Agentic Penetration Testing
Hundreds of hacker agents trained by elite ethical hackers to continuously discover, test, and validate your external exposures
Discover more
Adversarial Exposure Validation
Stop wasting time on false positives. Hadrian's agentic AEV delivers verified exposures to show exactly how an attacker would exploit them. By pinpointing only exploitable weaknesses, we boost time to remediation by up to 80% with zero operational overhead.
Discover more
Continuous Attack Surface Management
In a world of constant change, blind spots are your biggest threat. Hadrian's platform autonomously discovers and inventories your entire attack surface, saving security teams 10+ hours per week on average and ensuring you have 24/7 visibility into every external exposure.
Discover more
Threat Exposure Management
Move beyond alert fatigue and streamline remediation. Hadrian unifies your security data and prioritizes exposures with the highest likelihood of exploitation, cutting the Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR) by 80% to ensure your team focuses on what matters most.
Discover more
Detect Infostealers Infections
We ethically monitor the dark web to see if any edge devices in your network are infected with malware. Proactively monitor underground forums for the sale of leaked infostealer data, login credentials, and even session tokens to neutralize threats before they ever touch your network.
Discover more
Cloud Exposure Visibility and Control
Don't let complexity be your weak point. Our platform provides a clear, comprehensive view of your cloud-based systems, giving you deep insights into cloud exposures and enhancing your visibility into critical assets by 10x across multi-cloud environments.
Discover more
DNS Misconfigurations and Exposure
A single misconfiguration in your Domain Name System (DNS) can create a cascade of vulnerabilities. Identify and address DNS exposures that could lead to subdomain takeovers, phishing, and brand damage, protecting the very foundation of your web presence.
Discover more
